EvangelismRecord.title: EvangelismRecord
EvangelismRecord.description: A record of an individual met during church evangelism outreach by Gospel Labor Ministry, owned by a specific worker.

workerUid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the evangelism worker who created and owns this record

workerEmail.description: Email address of the evangelism worker who owns this record

fullName.description: Full name of the contact person

programs.description: Church programs invited to (e.g. Wednesday Program, Friday Program, Auxano, Sunday Service)

isNewConvert.description: Indicates whether the person gave their life to Christ as a new convert

respondedWell.description: Indicates whether the person responded warmly/receptively to the gospel

notes.description: Follow-up details, address, prayer requests, or comments from the encounter

evangelistName.description: Name of the church worker or evangelist who recorded the contact

date.description: Date of the encounter in DD/MM/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD format

followedUp.description: Whether a church worker has completed initial follow-up

isEstablished.description: Whether the contact has become an established believer in church fellowship

establishedAt.description: Date or timestamp when the record was marked as established

followUpNotes.description: Follow-up history, notes, or worker feedback

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the record was last updated

RemovedWorker.title: RemovedWorker
RemovedWorker.description: Record of a church worker whose access to outreach records has been revoked by an administrator

workerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the removed worker

workerEmail.description: Email address of the removed worker

workerName.description: Display name of the removed worker

removedAt.description: ISO timestamp when access was revoked

removedBy.description: Email or UID of administrator who revoked access

/records/{recordId}.description: Collection of outreach contacts recorded and owned by evangelism workers

/removedWorkers/{workerUid}.description: Collection of revoked worker access documents managed by administrators
